name: @w6w-apps/eventbrite
description: Create and run Eventbrite events end to end: events, tickets, inventory, discounts, orders, attendees, venues, questions and webhooks.

w6w.longDescription:
Eventbrite covers the whole event lifecycle from a workflow: create, update, copy, publish, unpublish, cancel and delete events, set their description and structured content, and add schedules to event series. Ticket classes, ticket groups, inventory tiers, capacity and seat maps can be read and changed, as can discounts, display settings and the checkout questions a buyer answers.

On the sales side it lists and fetches orders and attendees, refunds orders, and pulls sales and attendee reports. Venues, organizers, organization members and roles, event teams, categories, formats and media are available too, and organization webhooks can be created, listed and deleted.

A fit for publishing events from a CRM or content system, keeping attendee and order data in sync with a spreadsheet, opening a discount code when a campaign starts, or following up once an event's attendee list is known. Uploading an image is the one step that needs outside help: Eventbrite sends the file to a separate storage host, which this app cannot reach.
